author: Teckky
body:
Dear Avicans,

The day has come for me to step-down from my post as Moderator. I have so amazing memories on Avicus. So firstly let me thank all the people who have made my life way better.


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • Thank you IvyCode for all your hard work put into Avicus <3

  • Thank you Howsie22 for being a good friend, and a good brony <3

  • Thank you AviGill for whacking me into shape when I needed it <3

  • Thank you killerbye22 for has-ing so mush swag <3

  • Thank you yoavkipper for being a great friend <3

  • Thank you Shirokamii for making one of my fav maps <3

  • Thank you to all the Mods for everything you do, I would thank everyone but that would take all day <3

  • Thank you Map Devs, for being awesome <3
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

It has been a great time on Avicus (I still will be recording videos but just not as active on the forums)

Thank you to everyone who plays on this amazing, creative server.
